independence: Read only this assigned original scan, its neutral box list and generic protocol/helpers. No first TSV, witness, consolidated page, report, notes, notation table or comparison was opened.
inspection: All 20 boxes cropped once. Each enlarged PNG was successfully displayed individually. The display helper selected the original PNGs for all boxes. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used.

boxes.observation: Parenthesized diagonal marginal date 29.11.83. A tiny isolated fleck below the first numeral has no syntactic attachment and was excluded.
boxes.uncertainty: None for the date.

boxes.observation: Inserted annotation reads i.e. torseur sous, then double-stroked U with subscript 1 equal to a set of z in C with absolute value 1. A long curved attachment runs beneath the annotation and bends sharply downward near the upright contextual sentence. The upright sentence was excluded.
boxes.uncertainty: Far-right closing punctuation is close to the edge; the lower V-shaped bend is retained as part of the connector, with no separate arrowhead assigned.

boxes.observation: Multiline quotient definition beginning SRT(X). X in the first parenthesis has additional dark crossing strokes. The prose includes quotient du groupe, a compact autom-like abbreviation, orientation and structures toriques, then comp. neutre and sous-groupe. Aut has a raised exclamation mark and an arrow over X. Immediately afterward is a struck word; the tentative reading diag is retained. Last line reads l’identité sur partial X.
boxes.uncertainty: Initial X overstroke; autom abbreviation; small on before resp.; the struck word after Aut!(vector X). No expansion of the abbreviations was supplied.

boxes.observation: Upright line: On a ainsi un dévissage de SRT(X) en trois étages.
boxes.uncertainty: None material.

boxes.observation: Three separated mathematical terms S_*T!(X), double-stroked U^I, and a rounded script glyph with subscript I. Beneath the first term is an underbrace and Aut!(vector X)/comp. neutre. To the right is I=pi_0(partial X). No shafts connect the separated terms.
boxes.uncertainty: The rounded script glyph is retained with alternatives fraktur S_I / calligraphic G_I; the small subscript beneath S is dark but is read as a star.

boxes.observation: Four separated terms: double-stroked Z^I, T(X), double-stroked U^I, and the same rounded script glyph with subscript I.
boxes.uncertainty: Script S/G glyph retained as an explicit alternative.

boxes.observation: Upright line begins En fait, on définit, then a can-like abbreviation with raised t. Above R^I is a short added word with a two-armed attachment, read tentatively droit. The line ends de SRT(X).
boxes.uncertainty: Raised-t abbreviation and the supralinear word droit. The preceding display fragments at the top border were excluded.

boxes.observation: Top equation SRT!(X)=R^I dot S_*T!(X). A bracket beneath its left side introduces noyau de and a lower arrow from SRT! of a looped argument to the rounded script glyph with a raised prime and subscript I.
boxes.uncertainty: Lower argument is alpha-shaped and retained as alpha|X; target script S/G glyph and its small prime.
boxes.endpoints: The lower arrow has a visible small rightward head; the top bracket has curled ends, with no arrow assigned to it.

boxes.observation: Upper-left drawing has R^I at upper left and two vertically aligned dark dots near upper center. A horizontal arrow points left toward R^I. Beneath R^I is a canceled word, tentatively diagram, with local below. A left vertical shaft points downward toward Z^I; a central vertical shaft points upward from the S_*T! area and has a hooked lower end. The lower line has Z^I hooked-right-arrow S_*T!, then two subset glyphs linking SRT! and SRT. A large diagonal cancellation crosses a 2-like glyph above the lower row.
boxes.uncertainty: Canceled word diagram; exact identity of the crossed 2-like glyph. The two upper dots could function as a colon; both are explicitly drawn.
boxes.endpoints: Top horizontal head is leftward; left vertical head is downward; central vertical head is upward; lower horizontal head is rightward. The central lower end and lower horizontal left end are hooked.

boxes.observation: Diagonal note inspected after rotation. NB is underlined. The formula reads SUT(X) isomorphic to a T-like symbol of X, fiber-product cross over the rounded script-I glyph, then Aut((T_i) indexed i in I).
boxes.uncertainty: Calligraphic form of the first T-like symbol and the script S/G index glyph. The isolated black mark above the note belongs to crossing upright material and was excluded.

boxes.observation: Diagonal marginal prose inspected after rotation. Reads Jusqu’ici on ... fait intervenir que S_*T!(X), à l’exclusion de S_*T(X), ... la définition exige une str. suppl., then underlined s and cf ci-dessous. Upright crossing prose and diagram labels were excluded.
boxes.uncertainty: Short run n’a after on; abbreviation dt before la définition. These are retained without expanding the latter.

boxes.observation: Central five-node drawing: top SRT(X); central R^I dot S_*T!; left R^I; right S_*T!(X); bottom Z^I. One vertical shaft and two diagonals descend from the upper/central levels. Two lower diagonals run upward from Z^I toward the side objects. Shaft labels are the script-I glyph, T!, U^I, U^I, and T!(X). A left curved brace is labeled T(X), and a right curved brace is labeled Aut((T_i) indexed i in I).
boxes.uncertainty: Overwritten central S_*T!; script S/G glyph. The lower two upper endpoints have small thick triangular endings, retained as arrowheads; no separate heads are secure on the upper three shafts.
boxes.endpoints: Top-to-center and center-to-side connectors are plain in the reading. Bottom-to-left and bottom-to-right connectors have heads at their upper ends. Thick pen endings were not promoted to point markers.

boxes.observation: Introducing d’où; upper quotient SRT with heavily crossed material before /Z^I, equal by definition to SUT(X). One downward arrow leads to T!(X) times U^I. A right brace carries the rounded script-I label. A shallow wavy separator runs beneath the drawing.
boxes.uncertainty: Crossed group after SRT tentatively (X); script S/G label.

boxes.observation: Labeled (*) horizontal sequence: 1, U^I, SUT(X), an overdrawn T-like symbol of X, 1, connected by rightward arrows.
boxes.uncertainty: The penultimate T-like glyph is overdrawn; retained as uncertain calligraphic T. A separately recoverable prior deleted glyph is not secure.

boxes.observation: Two upright prose baselines: De plus, chaque fois qu’on se donne un marquage, i.e. un pt de. The following product formula and right marginal annotation were excluded here.
boxes.uncertainty: None material; pt retained as written.

boxes.observation: Underlined s equals (s_i), belongs to a product with index i in I=pi_0(partial X), followed by heavily crossed parenthesized material and a clean T_i.
boxes.uncertainty: Underlying crossed material has supported U_i/T_i-like alternatives, retained explicitly. Product index I has a separated top serif, retained as I rather than adding an overline.

boxes.observation: Right marginal annotation T_i: comp. connexe (torique) de partial X d’indice i. Below it is a detached small loop-and-stem glyph with a dot above, recorded separately as uncertain phi.
boxes.uncertainty: Detached glyph identity; it was retained, not discarded as a fleck.

boxes.observation: Prose on trouve un plongement, followed by a hooked rightward arrow from S_*T with crossed raised material, of (X, underlined s), to SRT(X); then tel qu’on en déduise.
boxes.uncertainty: Raised canceled mark after T is tentatively an exclamation mark; final word déduise is compressed. The isolated glyph above at right belongs to B17 and was excluded.

boxes.observation: Terminal formula has S_*T with raised crossed material, argument (X, underlined s), a wedge with lower index Z^I, then R^I, and an isomorphism relation to SRT(X).
boxes.uncertainty: Underlying raised canceled mark is tentatively !. The wedge shape and its low Z^I index were retained.

boxes.observation: Isolated lower-left marginal numeral 1 in lighter pencil-like strokes.
boxes.uncertainty: None for the numeral; no attribution visible.
